Two workers are present. The person in pink is very close on the wearer’s right, facing away toward the work area; the other person is several feet ahead near the wall, facing toward the wearer and appearing ready to receive a tool. A work platform lies between them, so approaching to clean or rearrange anything would obstruct the workspace. Passing the nearby sponge is the most direct, courteous response.
